story.then: For its first year, to September 2022, the gallery traded as Moarain House. The building has had other lives: Time Out says it was once an umbrella factory, and also the studio of the photographer Wolfgang Tillmans.
story.now: A small commercial gallery on the first floor, reached by stairs only, open Wednesday to Saturday from noon to 6pm. Time Out credits it with helping to keep Bethnal Green's art scene going.
story.vibe: The building is a graffiti-covered block on Cambridge Heath Road. Plaster magazine noted the gallery's plush pink carpet.
worth_knowing: The building was once the workspace of Wolfgang Tillmans, a photographer who has won the Turner Prize.
Before the art, the building housed an umbrella factory, according to Time Out.
